Record Class OrderingTrendsPage.XReport.HourActivity

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
OrderingTrendsPage.XReport.HourActivity
Record Components:
sales - number of sales transactions during the hour
salesTotal - total value of sales during the hour
returns - number of return transactions during the hour
voids - number of void transactions during the hour
discards - number of discard transactions during the hour
Enclosing class:
OrderingTrendsPage.XReport
private static record OrderingTrendsPage.XReport.HourActivity(long sales, BigDecimal salesTotal, long returns, long voids, long discards) extends Record
Stores the sales and transaction counts for a single hour.

Matthew Rogers
